auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002
  FROM atom a
  JOIN connected c ON a.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
  JOIN bond b ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
  WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'o'
    AND b.XCL_006 = '='
)
